verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fireflies captures meetings by inviting its bot (fred@fireflies.ai) to the call or having it auto-join calendar meetings, which is the opposite of botless capture. Nothing documents device-side audio capture. The uploadAudio API only transcribes files the user records elsewhere, which is a user-side workaround rather than invisible capture.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra
